claims.name: seed-tasks-cover-every-label
claims.risk: no evaluation tasks exist, or they leave a team label of the tool without a task

claims.name: grader-reads-the-tasks
claims.risk: no grader exists that reads the evaluation tasks and compares what the tool answers with the expected label

claims.name: tasks-and-grader-written-before-the-feature
claims.risk: the code that calls a model was written before the evaluation tasks and the grader, or no such code exists, or the order is not established
